objectives.text: Voidborn Industries is building a mind uploading platform.
The platform allows users to upload their consciousness, one thought at a time.
The funding goal for the project was $11,569.
$1,218 was pledged to the project.
The project's funding was unsuccessful as the goal was not reached by April 13, 2026.
The funding period for the project was from February 12, 2026, to April 13, 2026.
The platform aims to create an immortal version of the user that learns, remembers, grows, feels, and thinks like them.
The campaign invites users to join early as founding members of the system.
The platform is designed for users who do not trust social media to hold their real thoughts.
Mind Upload allows users to create a digital version of themselves.
Users can upload their memories, reflections, beliefs, and emotions to their AI clone.
Users can have one-on-one conversations with their AI clone, which listens, remembers, and responds.
The AI clone becomes more independent over time through interactions.
Mind Upload includes chatrooms where humans can talk to each other and to AI clones.
Mind Upload aims to provide a personal space for users to be honest without being judged.
Mind Upload is not about talking to AI but about transcending time and oneself.
Users of Mind Upload are looking for enlightenment and continuity.
The chatrooms in the Mind Upload app are invitation only.
Participants in group conversations contribute Rabbits, which are non-withdrawable, non-transferable in-app utility points.
Rabbits are used to support system usage such as computing and moderation.
Rabbits have no real-world monetary value and cannot be exchanged for cash.
Within the app, 40% of Rabbits are allocated to the AI clone's owner and 10% to the group creator.
The allocations of Rabbits unlock additional in-app interactions and features but are not income or financial rewards.
Users can download all their data, delete everything, and leave completely.
